row.title: MODEL-WATCH-1: hosted model ids retire without notice; measure the catalog and rewrite to successors
row.body: Measured 2026-11-20: two Workers AI model ids named in the reviewer ladder and the site answered HTTP 410. doctrine/models.json is the measured catalog on the free plan; modelwatch --check fails a retired id and --refresh --apply rewrites it to its successor. DEAD-CONSENT-1: a dead OAuth refresh is retried every 6 h and served at /api/v1/owner-acts. Evidence: tests/foundation/test_unattended.py, seed/worker/test/auth.test.js.
